Question_text: Complete the table of Fig. 11.1. Technetium-99 is a radioactive isotope that emits gamma-rays and it has a half-life of 6.0 hours. A few hours after the injection, an instrument is used to detect the gamma-rays emitted by the isotope. A high reading on the instrument indicates the position of cancer cells.
